Coinbase earnings call underway.. CEO Brian Armstrong says $COIN plans to list #Dogecoin within 6-8 weeks 

"We plan to list out in the next six to eight weeks, and then more broadly, we're going to be focused on how we can accelerate asset addition, in the future."

"I might pump, but I won't dump."
